tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.38.1;
father of: Shephatiah (H8203O)
§ Mattan = "a gift"
1) a priest of Baal in Jerusalem in the time of Athaliah
2) father of Shephatiah in the time of Jeremiah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite
